title: Pure Cyclone
summary: Pure Cyclone Quick-Play Spell control strategy centered on iconic backrow removal spells like Double Cyclone, Mystical Space Typhoon, and Cosmic Cyclone, paired with Toy Box and Artifact synergy. By deliberately destroying your own Set Spells and Traps with Double Cyclone, the deck triggers high-value float effects to wipe the opponent's field and assemble Rank 5 Xyz bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Toy Box places Toy Soldier and Toy Tank directly from your Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as face-down continuous Spell targets for Double Cyclone.
Double Cyclone is the core engine spell: targets 1 Spell/Trap you control and 1 Spell/Trap the opponent controls, destroying both simultaneously.
Toy Soldier sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone, and when sent to the GY while Set, Special Summons itself to search Artifact Moralltach from your Deck.
Toy Tank sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone, and when sent to the GY while Set, Special Summons itself to revive a Level 6 or lower monster from your GY.

summary.title: Opening: Toy Box + Double Cyclone
steps: Activate Toy Box and use its effect to Set Toy Soldier and Toy Tank from your Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as Spells.
Activate Double Cyclone, targeting your Set Toy Soldier and an opponent's Spell or Trap card to destroy both.
Trigger Toy Soldier in the GY to Special Summon itself to the field and search Artifact Moralltach from your Deck.
Set Artifact Moralltach (or Artifact Sanctum / Wild Tornado) in your Spell & Trap Zone to prepare for the opponent's turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate another Cyclone or Sanctum to Special Summon Moralltach and destroy an opponent's face-up card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Artifact Moralltach Special Summons itself when destroyed in the Spell & Trap Zone during the opponent's turn, destroying 1 face-up card the opponent controls without targeting.

Artifact Durendal is a Rank 5 Xyz that detaches an Xyz Material as a Quick Effect to change an opponent's monster effect or Spell/Trap activation into 'Destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls', triggering your own Set Moralltachs and Wild Tornados.
Constellar Pleiades is a Rank 5 LIGHT Xyz that detaches a material as a Quick Effect to bounce any card on the field back to the hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mystical Space Typhoon and Cosmic Cyclone provide versatile single-target removal, banishing problematic backrow or popping face-up floodgates.
Galaxy Cyclone destroys a Set Spell/Trap on the field, and banishes itself from the GY on a subsequent turn to pop a face-up Spell/Trap.
Wild Tornado destroys a face-up card in the Spell & Trap Zone, and if destroyed while Set by Double Cyclone, destroys any 1 face-up card on the field.
Artifact Sanctum Special Summons Artifact Moralltach directly from the Deck on the opponent's turn, and destroys any card on the field if destroyed while Set.
Night Beam destroys a Set Spell/Trap and prevents the opponent from chaining the targeted card.

Sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone as fodder for Double Cyclone and Special Summons itself to search Artifact Moralltach when sent to the GY.
Toy Tank
Sets itself in the Spell & Trap Zone and revives a monster when sent to the GY by Double Cyclone.
Artifact Moralltach
Set in the Spell & Trap Zone; when destroyed by Double Cyclone during the opponent's turn, it Special Summons itself and destroys 1 face-up card the opponent controls.
Cosmic Cyclone
Pays 1000 LP to banish 1 Spell/Trap on the field instead of destroying it.
Galaxy Cyclone
Destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap on the field, and banishes itself from the GY on a later turn to destroy 1 face-up Spell/Trap.
Double Cyclone
Core Quick-Play Spell that targets 1 Spell/Trap you control (Toy Soldier, Moralltach, or Wild Tornado) and 1 Spell/Trap the opponent controls and destroys both.
Mystical Space Typhoon
The original Cyclone Quick-Play Spell that destroys any 1 Spell/Trap on the field.
Night Beam
Destroys 1 Set Spell/Trap the opponent controls and prevents them from chaining the targeted card.
Toy Box
Places Toy Soldier and Toy Tank directly from the Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as live targets for Double Cyclone.
Artifact Sanctum
Special Summons Artifact Moralltach directly from the Deck on the opponent's turn.
Wild Tornado
Destroys any face-up card on the field when destroyed while Set by Double Cyclone.
